sourceFindings.classificationCaveat: The 2022 surface-water classification table is historical source context and is not interpreted as a current water-quality or safety assessment, fish-presence record, fishing-access rule, or species evidence.

limitations: Lengths and course descriptions are reported by the provincial profile and were not independently measured or traced as GIS geometry.
The source does not give station coordinates or a date-specific fish inventory for these channels.
A province-level name or course does not resolve every exact municipality, tributary identity, salinity zone, or channel boundary.
The profile does not grant item-specific reuse rights; no table, map, or image is reproduced here.
A source-reported water classification does not establish present-day safety, access, fishing rules, fish presence, or catchability.
